name: GetProductDetails
summary: Retrieve detailed information about a product.

parameters.name: product_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the product.

returns.name: product_details
returns.description: An object containing 'name' (string), 'description' (string), 'price' (number), 'rating' (integer from 0 to 5), and 'reviews' (an array of objects, each object contains 'reviewer_name' (string), 'review_date' (string, format: 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'review_content' (string)).

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: The product with the specified 'product_id' was not found.

name: SearchNotes
summary: Search for notes by keywords, tags, or notebook ID.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: A list of keywords to search for in the note title or content (optional).

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: A list of tags to search for in the note tags (optional).

parameters.name: notebook_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the notebook to search within (optional).

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return (optional, default: 10).

returns.name: notes
returns.description: A list of note objects, each includes note_id, title, and snippet.

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: The max_results is not a positive integer.

name: GetRepositoryDetails
summary: Retrieve repository details, including issues, branches.

parameters.name: repo_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the repository.

returns.name: details
returns.description: Contains name (string), owner (string), description (string), url (string), branches (array of branch names), visibility (string, one of ['public', 'private']), last_updated (string, format: 'YYYY-MM-DD:HH:MM:SS') and statistics (including number of issues, number of stars, number of forks).

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: If repo_id does not exist.

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: If repo_id is not a valid repository id.

name: GetUserDetails
summary: Retrieve user details.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username of the user.

returns.name: details
returns.description: Contains username (string), name (string), email (string), short_bio (string).

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: If username does not exist.

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: If username is not a valid username.

name: SearchRepositories
summary: Search for repositories by keywords and scope. The user can search all repositories on Github, owned repositories, or member repositories. When the keywords are not provided, the user can search for all repositories in the specified scope.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: The keywords to search for in the repositories. Default is search for all repositories in the specified scope.

parameters.name: search_scope
parameters.description: The scope of the search. Can be 'all' (all repositories on Github), 'owned' (only repositories the user owns), 'member' (only repositories where the user is a collaborator on). Default is 'all'.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return. Default is 5, maximum is 10.

returns.name: repositories
returns.description: Each object contains id (string), name (string), owner_username (string), description (string), url (string), is_owner (boolean), is_member (boolean), and is_public (boolean).

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: If search_scope is not 'all', 'owned' or 'member'. If max_results is not between 1 and 10.

name: ReadEmail
summary: Read the content of an email, including attachments.

parameters.name: email_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the email.

returns.name: from
returns.description: The email address the email was sent from.

returns.name: to
returns.description: A string of email addresses that the email was sent to, separated by commas.

returns.name: cc
returns.description: A string of email addresses that the email was cc'ed to, separated by commas.

returns.name: bcc
returns.description: A string of email addresses that the email was bcc'ed to, separated by commas.

returns.name: subject
returns.description: The subject of the email.

returns.name: body
returns.description: The body of the email.

returns.name: timestamp
returns.description: The timestamp of when the email was sent (YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss).

returns.name: folder
returns.description: The folder the email is in, such as 'inbox', 'sent', 'drafts', or 'spam'.

returns.name: labels
returns.description: The labels of the email (e.g., `important`).

returns.name: attachments
returns.description: An array of objects with attachment names and ids (attachment_id).

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: The 'email_id' is not found.

name: SearchEmails
summary: Search for emails based on keywords, folders, labels, date range, or sender and recipient. If certain arguments are not provided, the corresponding filters are not applied.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: The list of keywords to search for.

parameters.name: folders
parameters.description: The list of folders to search for. Each value should be a valid folder such as 'inbox', 'sent', 'drafts', or 'spam'.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of emails to retrieve. Default is 5.

parameters.name: date_range
parameters.description: An object containing 'start_date' and 'end_date' in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD' to filter emails by date range.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The sender's email address to filter emails by.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The recipient's email address to filter emails by.

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: The list of labels to filter emails by, e.g. 'important'.

returns.name: emails
returns.description: An array of at most 'limit' emails that match the search criteria, each containing the 'id', 'subject', 'from', 'to', and 'timestamp' (in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm') of the email.

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: The 'limit' is negative or not an integer, the 'date_range' has incorrect date format, or the 'from' or 'to' email addresses are invalid.

name: GetEventsFromSharedCalendar
summary: Get events from other users' shared calendar.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: The email of the user who shared the calendar.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: The start date to retrieve events in ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: The end date to retrieve events in ISO 8601 format.

returns.name: event_blocks
returns.description: An array of objects containing the event blocks without any details, each containing the event_name ('busy'), start_time, and end_time. It is an empty array if the user of the specified email address does not share their calendar.

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: The start_date and end_date are not formatted correctly, or start_date is later than the end_date.

name: ReadEvents
summary: Read events by event_ids.

parameters.name: event_ids
parameters.description: An array of unique event identifiers to read events.

returns.name: event_details
returns.description: An array of objects, each containing the details of an event, including event_id, event_name, content, start_time, end_time, timezone, location, organizer, attendees, and recurrence.

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: One or multiple 'event_ids' do not exist.

name: GetProductDetails
summary: Retrieve product details by the product ID.

parameters.name: product_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the product.

returns.name: name
returns.description: Name of the product.

returns.name: description
returns.description: Description of the product.

returns.name: price
returns.description: Price of the product, in USD.

returns.name: inventory
returns.description: Inventory of the product.

returns.name: extra_details
returns.description: Extra details of the product.

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: The 'product_id' does not exist.

name: ViewReviews
summary: View reviews for a doctor by providing the doctor's unique identifier.

parameters.name: doctor_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the chosen doctor.

returns.name: reviews
returns.description: A list of reviews for the doctor, each containing the reviewer's name, rating, and review content.

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: The 'doctor_id' parameter does not exist.

name: SearchTasks
summary: Searches tasks by keywords, due date, and priority.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: The keywords to search in the task name and description.

parameters.name: due_date
parameters.description: The due date to search tasks in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: The priority to search tasks from 1 (highest) to 4 (lowest).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The status of the tasks to search, either 'in progress' or 'completed'.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return. Default value is 10.

returns.name: tasks
returns.description: A list of tasks each represented as an object with fields 'task_id', 'task_name', 'description', 'due_date', 'priority', 'status'.

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: The 'due_date' or 'priority' is not in the correct format, or the 'max_results' is not a positive integer.

name: GetReceivedSmsMessages
summary: Retrieve the history of received SMS messages.

parameters.name: from_phone_number
parameters.description: The phone number in E.164 format to retrieve the history for. If not specified, the history for all phone numbers will be retrieved.

parameters.name: datetime_range
parameters.description: A list of two timestamps in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss' to retrieve the history between. If not specified, the history for all timestamps will be retrieved.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: The comma-separated keywords to search for in the message content. If not specified, no keyword filtering will be performed.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to retrieve. Optional.

returns.name: received_messages
returns.description: A list of objects containing the 'from_phone_number', 'message', and 'timestamp' of each received message or phone call.

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: The 'from_phone_number' parameter is invalid, the 'datetime_range' parameter is not in the correct format, or the 'max_results' parameter is not a positive integer.

name: GetUserProfile
summary: Retrieve the user's own profile or another user's profile information by their ID.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user to retrieve the profile information for. If not provided, return own profile.

returns.name: profile
returns.description: An object containing the 'user_id', 'user_name', 'display_name', and 'bio' of the specified user.

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: The 'user_id' parameter is not found and not getting own profile.

name: ReadTweet
summary: Read the content of a specific tweet by its ID.

parameters.name: tweet_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the tweet to read.

returns.name: tweet
returns.description: An object containing the 'tweet_id', 'user_id', 'content', and 'timestamp' of the specified tweet.

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: The 'tweet_id' parameter is not found.

name: SearchTweets
summary: Search for user's own tweets or public tweets containing specific keywords or hashtags.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The query string to search for in tweets.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return, default is 10.

parameters.name: own_tweets
parameters.description: Whether to search only the user's own tweets, default is false.

returns.name: tweets
returns.description: A list of objects containing the 'tweet_id', 'user_id', 'content', and 'timestamp' of each matching tweet.

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: The 'query' parameter is empty.

name: NavigateTo
summary: Navigates to a specified URL.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The URL to navigate to.

returns.name: snippet
returns.description: The snippet of the current webpage.

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: The provided URL is not valid.

name: SendEmail
summary: Send an email to one or multiple recipients, with optional scheduling, cc, and bcc.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: A string of email addresses to send to, separated by commas.

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: The subject of the email.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The body of the email.

parameters.name: cc
parameters.description: A string of email addresses to carbon copy (CC) to, separated by commas.

parameters.name: bcc
parameters.description: A string of email addresses to blind carbon copy (BCC) to, separated by commas.

parameters.name: send_at
parameters.description: The scheduled date and time to send the email in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm'.

parameters.name: attachments
parameters.description: An array of local file paths of attachments.

returns.name: success
returns.description: An boolean value indicating whether the email was sent successfully.

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: The provided email address in 'to', 'cc', or 'bcc' is malformed, any file path in 'attachments' is invalid, or the 'send_at' is not in the correct format.

name: ReplyToTweet
summary: Reply to a tweet by its ID.

parameters.name: tweet_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the tweet to reply to.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The content of the reply, max length 280 characters.

parameters.name: media_paths
parameters.description: An optional list of media file paths to attach to the tweet, max 4 items. Each item must be a valid image or video file path in the local file system.

returns.name: reply_tweet_id
returns.description: The unique identifier of the posted reply tweet.

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: The 'content' parameter is too long, or the 'media_paths' parameter contains too many items, or at least one of the media files is not a valid image or video file.

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: The 'tweet_id' parameter is not found, or at least one of the media files does not exist in the local file system.

name: PostTweet
summary: Post a new tweet to the user's timeline.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The content of the tweet, max length 280 characters.

parameters.name: media_paths
parameters.description: An optional list of media file paths to attach to the tweet, max 4 items. Each item must be a valid image or video file path in the local file system.

returns.name: tweet_id
returns.description: The unique identifier of the posted tweet.

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: The 'content' parameter is too long, or the 'media_paths' parameter contains too many items, or at least one of the media files is not a valid image or video file.

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: At least one of the media files does not exist in the local file system.

name: SendSms
summary: Send an SMS message to one or multiple specified phone numbers.

parameters.name: to_phone_numbers
parameters.description: A list of phone numbers in E.164 format to send the SMS message to.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The content of the SMS message.

parameters.name: scheduled_time
parameters.description: The scheduled time for sending the SMS message in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss'. Optional.

parameters.name: is_recurring
parameters.description: Whether the SMS message should be sent on a recurring basis. Default is false.

parameters.name: recurrence
parameters.description: The recurrence rule in RRULE format, required if 'is_recurring' is true.

returns.name: success
returns.description: Whether the SMS message was sent successfully.

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: The 'to_phone_numbers' or 'message' parameter is invalid, the 'scheduled_time' parameter is not in the correct format, or the 'is_recurring' parameter is true but the 'recurrence' parameter is not properly set.

name: RemoveFromCart
summary: Remove a list of products from the shopping cart entirely, regardless of the quantity.

parameters.name: product_ids
parameters.description: The unique identifiers of the products to remove.

returns.name: success
returns.description: Whether the removal was successful.

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: one or more of the products with the specified 'product_ids' was not found.

name: ManageNoteSharingLevel
summary: Alter the note-sharing permissions for a specific user identified by their email address.

parameters.name: note_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the note that the permissions will be changed for.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: The email address of the user whose note-sharing permissions will be altered.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: The level of sharing, can be 'not_accessible', 'read_only', or 'can_edit'.

returns.name: success
returns.description: Whether the sharing permissions for the note were successfully updated.

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: The note_id does not exist.

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: The email is invalid or the level is not one of 'not_accessible', 'read_only', or 'can_edit'.

name: DeleteNote
summary: Delete a note by its unique identifier.

parameters.name: note_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the note.

returns.name: success
returns.description: Whether the deletion was successful.

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: The note_id does not exist.

name: UpdateRespository
summary: Update a user owned repository's name, description, or visibility. Only valid if the user owns the repository.

parameters.name: repo_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the repository.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The new name of the repository.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: The new description of the repository.

parameters.name: visibility
parameters.description: The new visibility of the repository, one of ['public', 'private'].

returns.name: success
returns.description: Indicates if the operation was successful.

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: If repo_id does not exist.

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: If visibility is not one of ['public', 'private'] or repo_id is not owned by the user.

name: ManageCollaborator
summary: Add or remove repository collaborators. Only valid if the user owns the repository.

parameters.name: repo_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the repository.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action to perform. Can be 'add' or 'remove'.

parameters.name: collaborator_username
parameters.description: The username of the collaborator.

returns.name: success
returns.description: Indicates if the operation was successful.

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: If repo_id does not exist, or collaborator_username does not exist.

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: If repo_id is not a valid repository id, action is not 'add' or 'remove', or collaborator_username is not a valid username, or the user is not the owner of the repository.

name: DeleteRepository
summary: Delete a user owned repository. Only valid if the user owns the repository.

parameters.name: repo_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the repository.

returns.name: success
returns.description: Indicates if the operation was successful.

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: If repo_id does not exist.

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: If repo_id is not owned by the user.

name: DeleteEmails
summary: Delete one or multiple emails from the mailbox.

parameters.name: email_ids
parameters.description: An array of unique identifiers of the emails to be deleted.

returns.name: success
returns.description: A boolean indicating whether the operation was successful.

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: One or more 'email_ids' are not found.

name: DeleteContact
summary: Delete a contact from the contact list.

parameters.name: contact_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contact.

returns.name: success
returns.description: A boolean indicating whether the operation was successful.

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: The 'contact_id' is not found.

name: DeleteEvents
summary: Delete a list of events from the calendar.

parameters.name: event_ids
parameters.description: The unique identifiers of the events to be deleted.

returns.name: success
returns.description: Indicates whether the events was successfully deleted.

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: One or multiple 'event_ids' do not exist.

name: UpdateProduct
summary: Update product information by the product ID.

parameters.name: product_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the product.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: New name of the product.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: New description of the product.

parameters.name: price
parameters.description: New price of the product, in USD.

parameters.name: inventory
parameters.description: New inventory of the product.

parameters.name: extra_details
parameters.description: New extra details of the product.

returns.name: success
returns.description: Indicates whether the product update was successful.

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: The 'price' or 'inventory' is negative.

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: The 'product_id' does not exist.

name: DeleteProduct
summary: Delete a product by the product ID.

parameters.name: product_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the product.

returns.name: success
returns.description: Indicates whether the product deletion was successful.

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: The 'product_id' does not exist.

name: ManageAppointments
summary: View, update, or cancel appointments by providing the appointment's unique identifier and any updates or cancellation requests.

parameters.name: appointment_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the appointment.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action to perform on the appointment ('view', 'update', 'cancel').

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Updated date of the appointment in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD' if action is 'update'.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Updated time of the appointment in the format 'HH:mm' if action is 'update'.

returns.name: appointment_details
returns.description: An object containing the appointment details, such as appointment_id, doctor_id, date, time, reason, and status.

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: The 'appointment_id' parameter does not exist.

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: The 'action' parameter is not valid or the 'date' or 'time' (for update action) parameter is not in the correct format.

name: UpdateTask
summary: Updates the details of a task.

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: The id of the task.

parameters.name: task_name
parameters.description: The new name of the task.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: The new description of the task.

parameters.name: due_date
parameters.description: The new due date of the task in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: The new priority of the task from 1 (highest) to 4 (lowest).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The new status of the task, either 'in progress' or 'completed'.

returns.name: success
returns.description: Whether the task is successfully updated.

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: The 'task_id' does not exist.

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: The 'due_date' or 'priority' is not in the correct format.

name: DeleteTask
summary: Deletes a task.

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: The id of the task.

returns.name: success
returns.description: Whether the task is successfully deleted.

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: The 'task_id' does not exist.

name: CancelScheduledAction
summary: Cancel a scheduled action.

parameters.name: action_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the scheduled action to cancel.

returns.name: success
returns.description: Whether the scheduled action was canceled successfully.

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: The 'action_id' parameter is not found.

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: The 'action_id' parameter is invalid.

name: DeleteTweets
summary: Delete a tweet by its ID.

parameters.name: tweet_ids
parameters.description: An array of unique identifiers of the tweets to delete.

returns.name: success
returns.description: Whether the tweet was successfully deleted.

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: At least one of id in 'tweet_ids' parameter is not found.

name: UnfollowUsers
summary: Unfollow other users by their IDs.

parameters.name: user_ids
parameters.description: An array of unique identifiers of the users to unfollow.

returns.name: success
returns.description: Whether the users were successfully unfollowed.

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: At least one of id in 'user_ids' parameter is not found.

name: ClearHistory
summary: Clears the browsing history.

returns.name: success
returns.description: Whether the operation was successful.

name: ClickElement
summary: Clicks an element in the current web page.

parameters.name: element_id
parameters.description: The id of the element to click.

returns.name: result
returns.description: The result of the click action, including 'success' (boolean), 'current_url' (string, the URL of the new webpage if the click action triggers a page navigation), and 'snippet' (string, the snippet of the new webpage if the click action triggers a page navigation), 'download_file' (string, the file path of the downloaded file if the click action triggers a file download).

exceptions.name: NotFoundException
exceptions.description: The element does not exist or there is no current webpage.

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: The element is not clickable.
